item.title: CELTIC OFFER DEAL TO EURO DESTROYER
item.description: CELTIC have offered a pre-contract deal to RB Leipzig midfielder Xaver Schlager. The 28-year-old Austrian international will become a free agent when his contract at the Bundesliga club expires at the end of the season. The German outfit admitted Schlager has knocked back the opportunity of signing an extension and will be leaving in the summer. [...]
